scope.provider: Scripted ACP process through the public ArchivalReconstructionService workflow
scope.coverage: The successful admitted attempt requires the host-produced CREATED change to have no preimage digest, an afterSha256 matching the exact expected source bytes, and sizeBytes equal to that source. The reconstructed project, published source-tree, and verified extracted archive must all contain those same bytes. Reconstruction returns a successful build and no unresolved entities. ACP change records are derived by the host from initial/final workspace snapshots; the protocol does not accept agent-declared change claims to forge on this path.
